title: Demon at the Stained Glass Portal
description: A blue demonic figure with large curved horns, glowing red eyes, and a tattered red coat emerges from a dark stone archway on the left. To the right, a large ornate stained glass window reveals a vibrant European city street at sunset with colorful market awnings, historic buildings, and a domed cathedral under a fiery orange sky.
prompt: A menacing blue demon with large orange horns, glowing red eyes, and a tattered red coat stands at the threshold of an ancient stone archway covered in ivy. Beside him is a massive arched stained glass window depicting a beautiful European city street at sunset with colorful market stalls, historic buildings, and a prominent domed cathedral in the distance, dramatic lighting, highly detailed fantasy illustration
